name: PhoneInput
description: A phone number input with a country code selector button. Displays the dial code for common countries and accepts digits-only input with inputMode='tel'.

notes: The container has role='group' with aria-label='Phone number input'.
The phone input has aria-label='Phone number' for screen readers.
The country button has an aria-label describing the selected country and dial code.
Focus indicator uses a 2px solid outline with var(--color-border-focus) and a 2px offset.

onChange.description: Called when the phone number changes. Receives digits only.

country.description: ISO 2-letter country code. Determines the dial code shown.

onCountryChange.description: Called when the country code changes.

disabled.description: Disables both the country button and the phone input.

size.description: Controls the input height, padding, and font size.

error.description: Shows an error (invalid) border style using color-border-danger.

positive.description: Shows a positive (success/valid) border style using color-border-success.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the phone number input.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the outer wrapper div.

do: Use with a FormLabel to provide an accessible name for the group.
Use the onChange callback to receive digits-only values.
Pair with onCountryChange to allow users to switch country codes.
dont: Do not use inline styles to adjust appearance — add a token and use var(--token-name) in the CSS.
Do not omit a label — if a visible label is not possible, provide aria-label on the wrapper.
